patch_description: This replaces the monotonic trend-locking tracker with a robust, innovation-adaptive Kalman filter. A short causal median/regression observation stage removes impulsive noise without trailing-average phase delay. The Kalman process noise increases automatically during maneuvers, allowing rapid tracking of genuine turns, while a CUSUM-style hysteretic reversal controller briefly suppresses isolated counter-trend movements rather than permanently clamping the output. This preserves substantially more waveform dynamics and correlation while still penalizing noise-driven reversals.
